defect_observations.observation: Source fidelity: says Saltelli and Annoni 'give computational recipes for independent inputs only, referring the dependent case to other work'. At p.1512 Sect. 5.4 the article gives no recipe of its own. It refers the independent case to Saltelli (2002) and Saltelli et al. (2010) and the non-independent case to Saltelli and Tarantola (2002) and Da Veiga et al. (2009). No component verdict depends on this sentence.

Calls thm:p15-global-dependent-boundary 'the member rho=1 with output Y=X_1'. The host example uses a {0,1}-valued U with V=1/4 (host annex l.331 and l.335-336), while P_1 lives on {-1,1}^2 with V=1. The identification holds only after the unstated relabeling 2U-1, which leaves the indices unchanged.

Curvature-family proof writes the conditional computation only for factor 1 and gets S_2=S_T2=Var(g_2(X_2))/V by 'likewise'. The step is symmetric, but it is not written out. No coverage verdict depends on it: C04 asks for a report, and the dependence and threshold results it also relies on are fully proved.

Body says marginal resampling evaluates f at probability-zero combinations 'when |rho|=1'. The supporting annex sentence (069 annex l.198-200) argues only rho=1 (x3=x1); the rho=-1 case (x3=-x1) is not written.
